verdict.rationale: Foreloop's docs describe a direct feedback-to-task flow. The widget collects submissions with page context and screenshots, and a PM triages each one as real or spam. A real submission becomes an intention: an agent reads it, fills in the purpose and editable deliverables, and proposes tasks, which a person must approve as a contract before work runs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent-drafted tasks, and detail on how the proposed tasks and their scope fields are structured.
